attributes.name: Vestments of Authority
attributes.powers:
On your combat or Diplomacy check against a card that has the Basic, Elite, or Veteran trait, reveal this card to add 1, or 2 if you have the Divine skill.

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, bury it instead.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
